title: Unstable-V
description: Welcome to the Unstable-V. UnstableSMP but with compound-V
body:
This server is a server where people who are fans of UnstableSMP band who are also fans of The Boys combined.

It is an Unstable Fan server but with a twist, it has compound-V.
server is NA.

The server is a unique UnstableSMP, with the item of getting compound, temp, and v one. all of the types of V's from the Amazon prime exclusive "TheBoys" this is a way to have a cool change either then having just the basic UnstableSMP experience. Hope to see all of you around!
